k:台.mnemonic: A cocoon (厶) on top of a mouth (口): a little thing set on a big square base. A pedestal (stand, platform).
k:台.hint: Something small on a big base.

k:矛.mnemonic: A spear standing on its end: the point at the top, the shaft, and a tassel hanging off. Spear.

k:里.mnemonic: A rice field (田) over soil (土). Where the fields meet the soil is the hometown. Hometown.

k:野.mnemonic: Beyond the hometown (里) you need a spear (矛), because out there is the open field. Field (plains, wild).

k:矢.mnemonic: An arrowhead on top with the shaft and fletching below. Arrow.

k:知.mnemonic: An arrow (矢) next to a mouth (口). Words that fly straight as arrows come from someone who knows. Know.

k:以.mnemonic: A stick (｜), a drop (丶) and a person (人): a person stirring a pot with a stick and a drop flying out. They do it by means of the stick. By means of (from, since).

k:世.mnemonic: Three tens (十) joined at the bottom: thirty years, the length of a generation. Generation (world).

k:対.mnemonic: A sentence (文) versus a measurement (寸). Words against numbers: two sides facing off. Versus (opposite, pair).

k:西.mnemonic: A bird settling into its nest as the sun goes down in the west. West.
k:西.hint: Bird in a nest at sunset.

k:全.mnemonic: A hat (𠆢) on the king (王). With his crown on, the king is complete: the whole of him. Whole (all).
k:全.hint: King with his hat on: complete.

k:死.mnemonic: Bones (歹) with an evening (夕) and a spoon (匕): someone kneeling over a pile of bones. Death.

k:又.mnemonic: A right hand with the fingers together. It keeps reaching out, again and also again. Also.

k:止.mnemonic: A footprint: heel at the bottom, toes pointing up. The foot has stopped here. Stop.

k:度.mnemonic: Under a canopy (广) is a pit (凵) and a hand (又) reaching in to measure how deep it is, in degrees. Degrees (occurrence, extent).

k:正.mnemonic: One (一) line on top of stop (止). Stop right at the line: that is correct. Correct (justice).

k:丁.mnemonic: A nail seen from the side, head at the top. Nails are laid out in a row like houses along a street. Street.
k:丁.hint: A nail, like a row of houses.

k:衣.mnemonic: A lid (亠) on top like a collar, and the folds of a robe hanging beneath. Garment.

k:町.mnemonic: A rice field (田) beside a street (丁). Fields with a street between them: a town. Town.

k:表.mnemonic: A samurai (士) over a garment (衣). The samurai's garment shows on the surface. Surface (express, table).

k:早.mnemonic: The sun (日) on top of a ten (十), like a sunflower on its stalk. The sunflower faces the sun early in the morning. Early.

k:心.mnemonic: A heart with three drops of blood pumping out of it. Heart (mind).

k:朝.mnemonic: Ten (十) above early (早), with the moon (月) beside it. The moon still up while the sun is early: morning. Morning.
k:朝.hint: Sun up early with the moon still out.

k:母.mnemonic: A kneeling figure (like 女) with two dots for the breasts. Mother.

k:毎.mnemonic: A hairpin (𠂉) over a mother (母). Every single day mother puts in her hairpin. Every.

k:海.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) hits every (毎) shore. That great water is the sea. Sea.

k:多.mnemonic: Two evenings (夕) stacked up. Evening after evening after evening: many. Many.
